summary: {person} asks what passengers and drivers each observed before changing the timetable.
realLife: Milwaukee’s June service update attributed reliability adjustments on fifteen routes to feedback from riders and operators.
gates: The agency is reviewing service reliability using passenger and operator reports.
weights: Repeated delays at the same time of day make paired observations more persuasive.
inGame: needs: rider feedback, operator reports, observed running time and proposed timetable.

turns.what: Schedulers test an adjustment on the affected trip.
turns.pulledBy: Both accounts identify the same delay.
turns.writesBack: Record the trial time in the next schedule.

turns.what: Staff compare the reports with actual arrivals.
turns.pulledBy: Drivers and riders report different trouble spots.
turns.writesBack: Retain both observations pending a timing check.
